title: The Angry Little Dragon: How Deep Breaths Cool the Fire!

lines.text: Sparky the little dragon was building the tallest marble run in Dragon Valley!
lines.caps: Sparky the little *DRAGON | was building the tallest marble *RUN | in Dragon *VALLEY!

lines.text: A sudden gust of wind blew the whole tower down with a loud CLATTER!
lines.caps: A sudden gust of *WIND | blew the whole tower down with a loud *CLATTER!

lines.text: Sparky's cheeks puffed up, smoke puffed from his nose, and his temper boiled!
lines.caps: Sparky's cheeks puffed *UP, | smoke puffed from his nose, and his *TEMPER | *BOILED!

lines.text: He stomped his feet and was about to roar fire and scorch the grass!
lines.caps: He stomped his *FEET | and was about to roar *FIRE | and scorch the *GRASS!

lines.text: His mama gently placed her paw on his shoulder and said, Smell the flowers!
lines.caps: His mama gently placed her *PAW | on his shoulder and said, *SMELL | the *FLOWERS!

lines.text: Sparky breathed in through his nose like smelling roses... one, two, three!
lines.caps: Sparky breathed in through his *NOSE | like smelling roses... *ONE, | two, *THREE!

lines.text: Then he blew out through his mouth like cooling birthday candles... whooooosh!
lines.caps: Then he blew out through his *MOUTH | like cooling birthday candles... *WHOOOOOSH!

lines.text: Three deep breaths cooled the lava in his chest and brought back his bright smile!
lines.caps: Three deep breaths cooled the *LAVA | in his chest and brought back his bright *SMILE!

lines.text: Breathe easy and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily emotional skills!
lines.caps: *BREATHE easy and | *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for daily emotional *SKILLS!
